subject.title: feat: add copyable message citation links

question: Should ClickClack make stable, copyable citation URLs for all channel-root messages a supported permanent product contract, including backfilling existing channel roots?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing capability with persistent public identifiers and an upgrade-time backfill; correctness evidence alone cannot establish whether that product and compatibility commitment is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded citation contract
options.body: Accept channel-root-only citations and require final upgrade and browser-proof review before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the feature
options.body: Keep the issue open and define a smaller supported URL or migration scope before accepting implementation work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded citation contract
recommendation.body: Accept channel-root-only citations and require final upgrade and browser-proof review before merge.
